chunks: And Ali, peace be upon him, said:
"The wind has a head and two wings."

key_terms.الرِّيحِ: the wind, a created natural force being described
key_terms.جَنَاحَانِ: two wings, indicating paired sides or means of movement
key_terms.رَأْسٌ: a head, indicating a leading or foremost aspect
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ: Imam Ali عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام say about the nature of the wind?
ai.summary: Imam Ali عليه السلام describes the wind with the expression that it has a head and two wings. The statement presents a concise depiction of the wind’s ordered nature and distinctive movement within creation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1517 - Imam Ali (as) said: "The wind has a head and wings."
